core: HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress-linked behavior
qualifier: social, mating and aggressive behaviors
name: HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress-linked social behaviors
rationale: Members combine CRH/ACTH-driven corticosteroid secretion and response with stress, fear, mating, parental and aggressive behaviors; the glucocorticoid-secretion arm separates it from the neuropeptide/sleep confusable and the behavioral arm from the glucocorticoid-response confusable.

qualifier: Leloir pathway, glucuronate-xylulose route and their inborn errors
name: Galactose Leloir and pentose-glucuronate catabolism with inborn errors
rationale: All members are Leloir galactose catabolism or pentose/glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies; galactose and pentose content distinguishes it from the fructose and pentose-phosphate-shunt confusables.

qualifier: E-cadherin turnover/trafficking and cadherin-11 signaling
name: E-cadherin turnover and trafficking and cadherin-11 signaling
rationale: Members concern post-translational handling of CDH1 (degradation, trafficking, Listeria InlA entry, indole-3-carbinol response) and CDH11 interactions/STAT3 signaling, whereas confusables cover cadherin gene transcription, EMT or adherens junction assembly.

core: Two-pore-domain potassium channels and pain sensing
qualifier: thermal and mechanical nociception
name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels and thermal/mechanical pain detection
rationale: Members are K2P channel families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, THIK, TRESK) with resting potential control plus detection of noxious heat and mechanical stimuli; the pairing separates it from confusables lacking either the K2P channels or the pain-detection terms.

qualifier: white, brown and beige fat cells with PPAR regulation
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and adipose development
rationale: All members regulate fat cell differentiation, proliferation and adipose tissue development via PPARG-linked transcription; this lineage focus distinguishes it from confusables on hepatic lipid/gluconeogenic gene regulation and cold-induced thermogenesis.

qualifier: with GTPase activity control
name: Regulation of nuclear protein import/export and GTPase activity
rationale: Most members regulate NLS-dependent nuclear import and export of proteins together with GTPase activation/inactivation (the two broad expression modules are only loosely tied via TSC2 GAP activity and nuclear regulators), distinguishing it from confusables on nuclear pore structure, senescence foci or viral protein maturation.

core: Mitochondrial respiratory chain and oxidative phosphorylation
qualifier: heme and iron-sulfur cofactor biosynthesis
name: Respiratory chain assembly with heme and iron-sulfur cofactor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover electron transport, complex I-IV and ATP synthase assembly, plus the heme, Fe-S and ubiquinol cofactors they require; the cofactor-synthesis arm separates it from confusables on mitochondrial import, translation or the TCA cycle.

qualifier: CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
name: Proximal TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
rationale: Members are CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 recruitment and CD28 costimulatory or CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibitory inputs at TCR engagement, distinguishing them from B cell receptor and downstream T cell activation/differentiation confusables.

qualifier: TGFBR3 co-receptor, activin/AMH and TGFBR1-SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling via TGFBR3 co-receptor and TGFBR1 mutants
rationale: Members concern receptor-level TGF-beta superfamily signaling (TGFBR3 regulation, activin/follistatin, AMH, TGFBR1 and SMAD2/3 phosphorylation-site mutants), whereas confusables emphasize SMAD4/TGFBR2 mutants, downstream SMAD transcription or gonadotropin secretion.

qualifier: mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ programme and proliferation
name: Mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ fibroblast stromal programme and proliferation
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal expression modules driven by mechanical and growth-factor cues (YAP/TAZ targets, caveolin, collagen/TGF-beta) plus fibroblast proliferation and focal adhesion assembly, distinguishing it from ECM/EMT and migration-centred confusables.

qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6-mediated IRF and NF-kB activation
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling via TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB
rationale: Members trace RLR antiviral signaling through FADD/RIP1 and TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF7 and NF-kB activation (including RSV evasion), whereas confusables center on RIG-I/MDA5 regulation and dsRNA responses.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism with inborn errors
name: Purine de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism with inborn errors
rationale: All members are purine (deoxy)nucleotide synthesis via PRPP/IMP, salvage, degradation to allantoin and HPRT/APRT/PNP/ADA deficiencies, distinguishing it from pyrimidine and nucleoside-triphosphate hydrolysis confusables.

qualifier: SALM and receptor tyrosine phosphatase complexes, positive and negative regulation
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion regulating synapse assembly via SALMs and RPTPs
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion molecules (SALMs, RPTPs), neuron adhesion and pre/postsynaptic assembly with its positive and negative regulation, while confusables are defined by neurexin-neuroligin and receptor/PSD-95 clustering.

qualifier: Fas/TRAIL-caspase-8 in T cell and cytotoxic immunity
name: Fas/TRAIL caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis in T-cell and cytotoxic immunity
rationale: Members are FasL/TRAIL-triggered caspase-8 activation, c-FLIP control and BID cleavage, together with activation-induced T cell death, allograft rejection and tumor-cell killing, separating it from necroptosis and mitochondrial apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor response, recruitment and degranulation
name: Neutrophil formyl peptide receptor response, recruitment and degranulation
rationale: Members describe neutrophil recruitment, FPR-mediated responses, complement receptor signaling and degranulation, combining both the FPR and degranulation arms that each confusable lacks.

qualifier: AP-site processing, gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects
name: Base excision repair gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 glycosylase defects
rationale: Members cover AP-site resolution, short- and long-patch gap filling and defective OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 glycosylases, whereas confusables focus on lesion recognition/cleavage and NEIL glycosylases.

qualifier: COPII anterograde export and COPI retrograde return
name: COPII ER-to-Golgi export and COPI retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading/coat formation at ER exit sites and COPI budding for Golgi-to-ER return, distinguishing it from ER targeting/quality-control and vesicle tethering confusables.

qualifier: TNF-receptor-driven canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical
name: TNF-receptor-driven canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members span TNFR1 canonical NF-kB with linear ubiquitination and IKBKB, and NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB via CD40, TNFSF members and Dectin-1, distinguishing it from lymphocyte/TLR NF-kB and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: classical, lectin and alternative routes to C3/C5 and MAC
name: Classical, lectin and alternative complement activation and regulation
rationale: Every member is a complement activation route, terminal pathway or its regulation, which no confusable shares (they cover antimicrobial, phagocyte and hypersensitivity programmes).

qualifier: podocyte, mesangial and glomerular basement membrane
name: Glomerular filtration barrier development: podocytes, mesangium, basement membrane
rationale: Members address glomerular endothelium, podocyte, mesangial and basement membrane development (nephrin, laminin) and filtration function, distinguishing it from tubule development and epithelial polarity/brush border confusables.

qualifier: Galpha12/13 and Sema4D upstream activation
name: Rho GTPase cycles and effectors with Galpha12/13 and Sema4D signaling
rationale: Members are Rho/Rac/Cdc42/Rnd GTPase cycles and their effectors (ROCK, PAK, formins, WASP/WAVE), with upstream Galpha12/13 and Sema4D-plexin activation that the actin-cytoskeleton confusables lack.

core: Innate cytosolic sensing and host defence
qualifier: cGAS-STING, inflammasome and GBP with dendritic cytokine/CCL5 output
name: cGAS-STING, inflammasome and GBP defence with dendritic cytokine production
rationale: Members combine cGAS-STING, inflammasome and GBP-mediated defence (including protozoa) with CCL5, STAT6 chemokine and dendritic-cell cytokine production, distinguishing it from type I interferon antiviral and Th1/IFN-gamma confusables.

qualifier: integrin activation, heterotypic adhesion and PECAM1
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
rationale: Members concern integrin activation and integrin-mediated heterotypic leukocyte adhesion (PECAM1, membrane docking, T cell surface), separating it from immunological-synapse and integrin-to-MAPK/Rap1 signaling confusables.

qualifier: epidermal wound repair
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation control in epidermal wound repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis and epidermal wound-healing proliferation/spreading, whereas confusables cover cornification and barrier, melanocyte/hair, or IL-20 wound inflammation.

qualifier: alpha- and beta-defensins
name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide production
rationale: All members concern alpha/beta-defensins and the biosynthesis and regulation of antibacterial peptides, distinguishing it from metal-sequestration, mucosal and neutrophil-cytotoxicity antimicrobial confusables.
